name: Amare Nugent
strengths: Nugent plays with active eyes in zone and breaks on the ball with timing from off and soft-press looks.
Nugent is physical in run support, working through perimeter blocks and finishing ball carriers.
Nugent uses his hands in press to disrupt releases and turn receivers at the line.
Nugent shows recovery speed when beaten a step and competes at the catch point.
weaknesses: Nugent can look stiff flipping his hips on sudden option breaks vs twitchy slot stems.
comparison: Nugent comps to Trent McDuffie -- compact ~5-11 zone/man corner with thicker frame, ball skills, and physical run support (size-matched to Nugent's 5-11 / 180 mold).
projection: Nugent projects as develop into the CB room, earn early special-teams and dime/nickel snaps, then compete for a starting nickel/boundary role -- starter upside as a physical coverage corner with ball instincts.
schemeFit: Nugent fits White's press/zone CB who can play boundary or nickel with physicality.
insiderNotes: Nugent plays with active eyes in zone and breaks on the ball with timing. Physical in run support through perimeter blocks, and uses his hands in press to disrupt releases — recovery speed when beaten a step and compete at the catch point.
